mintAuthority.summary: XAUm MToken minting is operator- or receipt-NFT-controlled and budget-limited by reserve/mint-budget accounting; the owner can change the operator. Ethereum and Sui State controls confirmed: owner EOA and operator verified on both chains.

controls.label: XAUm MToken operator mint path

MTokenMain.increaseMintBudget is callable by the operator and checks usedReserve against the configured reserve feed. The owner can replace the operator or feeds through the delayed administration path.

controls.label: XAUm receipt NFT mint path
controls.capDescription: mintTo is callable by the operator or configured nftContract, subject to the same mintBudget and delayed request. nftContract() at Ethereum block 26095797 returned this receipt NFT. The operator can increase the native mint budget subject to reserve-feed checks; the owner can replace operator, feeds and implementation through delayed paths.
controls.evidence: The verified MToken mintTo path permits calls from the configured NFT contract as well as the operator, subject to the same mintBudget accounting.

review.evidence: Historical Ethereum block 25295020 and Sui observations remain in the control evidence. At Ethereum block 26095797 on 2026-10-01, implementation 0x3194e478b6d3ebee969470295f271727b62adf7b, owner 0xb573c94260582f0715fc477928b04a2708dd36d7 (zero code), operator 0x89bb23e4a82e04a253d9f11767fedf321c127799, NFT 0x67dcc9c33363cc0e650738528fe4fef1d658c7ee and mintBudget zero were confirmed. delay() returned 14,400 seconds; verified source applies that delay to mint requests, operator/feed replacement and UUPS upgrades. increaseMintBudget is operator-only and checks the reserve feed; owner authority to replace the operator/feed/implementation remains. Both reserveFeed and fallbackFeed currently point to 0xb2624f7e72788f1ebf1c7877c646732957bbf72e. Bureau Veritas inspects physical inventory; the July token comparison is issuer-published, not an independent token-liability reconciliation.
